scope: SMIC18 TT 1.8V 27C; all 16 code centers in both original orders with original post-acquisition decoys; original nominal coherent dynamic records. SS/FF source corners excluded from nominal reproduction.
power_definition: Signed net delivered energy summed over VDD,VREFP,VCM,VINP,VINN,VCLKS; no omitted input/clock power.
fft: Rectangular, DC removed; bins 1..N/2-1 except tone plus half Nyquist; P_FS=(N*2^bits/4)^2.
nonrelaxable: Exact sample-hold codes in BOTH orders, all groups finite, digital sample levels outside [0.2VDD,0.8VDD], correct reset and conversion timing.
allowed: Native MOS and positive ideal capacitors; unmodified HD vendor cells for all digital logic.
